sentences.text: Niobrarasaurus coleii stands as the sole species within its extinct genus.
This armored dinosaur measured roughly 5 meters in length, stood 1.8 meters tall, and weighed between 227 and 453 kilograms.
However, a higher estimate by Paul suggests the animal reached 6.5 meters in length and weighed 4 tons.
It belonged to the nodosaurid ankylosaurian group, a lineage that lacked the club on its tail.

Niobrarasaurus is classified within the family Nodosauridae.
The genus authority is Carpenter et al., 1995.
The genus name Niobrarasaurus was chosen to honor the Niobrara Formation where the fossils were found.
The dinosaur lived at the end of the Cretaceous period, between 87 and 83 million years ago, during the Coniacian and Santonian stages.
The fossil record indicates a time range from the Coniacian to Santonian stages, between 89.8 and 83.6 million years ago.
Fossils of Niobrarasaurus were found in the Smoky Hill Chalk Member of the Niobrara Formation in western Kansas.
